referenceSources.title: Coche del día: Daihatsu Charade GTti - espíritu RACER
referenceSources.description:
A bright red Daihatsu Charade GTti sits in a clean, well-lit garage, highlighting its sporty hatchback profile. The rear three-quarter angle reveals the small roof spoiler, dual exhaust tips, and 14-inch alloy wheels. Badging on the tailgate and side decals emphasize its Twin Cam 12-valve turbocharged engine, while the license plate reads “G819 LNP.”

This subcompact model, introduced in 1987, was known for its agile handling and surprising performance from a 993 cm³ three-cylinder turbo engine producing 101 CV. The Espíritu RACER article notes its ergonomic interior, electric mirrors and windows, and a modest 155-liter trunk. Despite its advanced features and spirited driving character, high import tariffs made it an expensive choice in Spain at the time.
